title: Analysis code, literature-audit record and trial extraction for: Resting NAD+ sets the ceiling, not the dose — a quantitative criterion for vitamin B3 precursors across tissues
description: Supplementary Code S1 of the review manuscript. Reproduces every calculated value in the paper: the gain ceiling set by the resting concentration, the concentration above which no attainable NAD+ restores baseline sirtuin output, and the required elasticity together with the threshold that climbs with dose. Generates Figures 1, 3 and 4. Also carries the full coding record of the scoping audit of 297 full-text reviews (PRISMA-ScR) and the trial-by-trial extraction behind Figures 1 and 2. No new experimental data were generated; every input is taken from the published sources cited in the manuscript.
